notes.title: Patch v.0.1.1.7
notes.notes:
Work continues on the balance of the game. Work is actively underway on introducing bosses into the game.

[b]Fixed:[/b]
- Blow in a jump did not expend stamina

[b]Changed:[/b]

Character:
- heavy blows - damage + 30%, endurance consumption by 5%
- hit in the jump - damage + 100%, endurance consumption by 50%

Enemy PVE:
- increased block shield chance by 20%
- added lock shield conditions
